checks.note: Each task maps to exactly one capability-map entry; no task needs skill-internal knowledge.
All checks are file parsing, string equality, or ordering assertions. No subjective requirement.
Exact-equality checks (no-extra-keys, byte preservation, heading order) reject plausible-but-wrong outputs; partial credit is a measured fraction, not a guess.
Instructions are self-contained; bare control has an equal chance. Difficulty comes from precision, not missing context.
Tasks were authored from the capability map only; no skill text appears in prompts or verifiers.
